tools.name: list_workspaces
tools.description: List the Runledge workspaces the signed-in user can access, with plan and your role. Call this first to get a workspace_id.

tools.name: get_roi_summary
tools.description: Return actions, hours saved, losses prevented, token usage, spend and net value for a workspace over the last N days.

tools.name: list_actions
tools.description: List recent agent actions in a workspace, newest first, optionally filtered by status or agent.

tools.name: record_action
tools.description: Record an action an agent took (or was blocked from taking) with tokens, cost and value. Pass idempotency_key to make retries safe. Requires member role.

tools.name: list_approvals
tools.description: List human-in-the-loop approval requests in a workspace, optionally filtered by status.

tools.name: request_approval
tools.description: Put a high-impact action in the workspace approval queue for a human owner or admin to approve or reject in the Runledge console.

tools.name: evaluate_action
tools.description: Evaluate a proposed action against current workspace rules. Returns Allowed / Adjusted / Held / Blocked (compatibility values allowed / shaped / pending_approval / blocked). Adjusted returns shaped_action; callers send that version, never the original. No external action is executed.

tools.name: get_approval_status
tools.description: Check one approval request so a paused agent can resume. When approved, re-run evaluate_action with approval_id before executing the exact same proposal; when rejected, do not execute.

tools.name: execute_brokered_action
tools.description: Run a provider API call through a workspace credential the agent never sees. Runledge evaluates policy first and calls the provider only when allowed; the idempotency key guarantees at most one call. Held or Blocked proposals are recorded but not executed. Adjusted proposals are refused: this broker

tools.name: get_cost_center_report
tools.description: Departmental action volume, token spend and estimated operating value. Risk exposure is not realized savings; shared platform cost counted once.

tools.name: search_developer_docs
tools.description: Search Runledge API contracts and developer FAQs; cite returned sources when explaining integrations. Does not execute examples or change permissions.

tools.name: get_rule_recommendations
tools.description: Review the last 30 days of agent activity for uncovered actions and volume spikes, and return suggested rules. Suggestions are not applied. Team and above.

tools.name: compensate_run
tools.description: Start a rollback for a multi-step run. Returns the undo steps each action declared, newest first. Runledge does not call providers: execute each step yourself, then call record_action with compensates_action_id. Set dry_run to only read the run state. Requires member role.

tools.name: start_connection_check
tools.description: Open a ten-minute connection check. Pass its id as connection_check_id to evaluate_action or REST preflight; this executes no external action.

tools.name: get_connection_check
tools.description: Read the stored policy decision for an opt-in connection check; not proof of external execution.

tools.name: test_notification_channel
tools.description: Send one synthetic non-actionable notification or velocity-trip example to a subscribed channel. Requires policy management permission; one test per minute. Does not verify reviewer decisions.

tools.name: draft_policy_rules
tools.description: Draft up to five shadow-mode rules from operational language. Drafting is free and does not consume a paid-plan AI review. Fair-use limit: 20 drafts per hour. Unsupported requirements are flagged; no rules are saved or applied. Requires policy management permission.

tools.name: manage_partner_clearing
tools.description: Administrator operations: publish/revoke agent passports, set partner caps and incoming action vocabulary, run a zero-value staging bilateral policy handshake, or retrieve consent evidence. Handshakes are synthetic and audited on both sides, not live consent or external connectivity. Publishing pass

tools.name: exchange_partner_ticket
tools.description: Issue or accept an exact partner action ticket after both workspace policies. Administrator only; explicit human review required for probation acceptance. Acceptance records consent, never external execution or financial settlement.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_rule_recommendations · Private data: get_roi_summary, record_action, execute_brokered_action, get_cost_center_report, exchange_partner_ticket · Public sink: evaluate_action, test_notification_channel, manage_partner_clearing · Destructive: get_approval_status, execute_brokered_action, search_developer_docs, compensate_run, manage_partner_clearing.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_rule_recommendations · Private data: get_roi_summary, record_action, execute_brokered_action, get_cost_center_report, exchange_partner_ticket · Public sink: evaluate_action, test_notification_channel, manage_partner_clearing · Destructive: get_approval_status, execute_brokered_action, search_developer_docs, compensate_run, manage_partner_clearing

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
